title: CHISQ.TEST and CHITEST: an identity decomposition and two single-row ULP witnesses
status_plain: Probing CHIDIST at candidate statistic bit-patterns pinned Excel's internal statistic as the plain-double row-major sum of (o-e)^2/e, on the two of four contingency tables whose CHIDIST tail is steep enough to be injective. That identity work is Excel against Excel; it publishes no pass rate. The catalogue's conclusion that ALL CHISQ.TEST drift is inherited from CHIDIST is a CAUSAL claim and must never be turned into an inherited pass rate. The only per-surface measurement either surface has is a single tracked recon row each -- 8 ULP and 7 ULP -- which is a divergence, not a count.

reader_warning: "All CHISQ.TEST drift is inherited from CHIDIST" is a statement about cause. It does not give these surfaces CHIDIST's 152 of 195 or any other pass rate. Note also an upstream inconsistency worth seeing rather than smoothing: G3-05 is graded NUM-L and G3-06 NUM-S on identical inheritance logic.
